name: Fruit Ninja Classic+
summary:
Slice fruit, don't slice bombs – that is all you need to know to get started as a Fruit Ninja!

The original hit returns to satisfy your fruit-destroying appetite, now with juicy updates. Slice for a high score, line up combos for extra points, and go crazy on the multi-slice Pomegranate!

Survive the longest you can in Classic mode, go wild with special bananas in Arcade mode, or relax and practice your fruit-slicing skills in Zen mode.

Collect Blades and Dojos so you can slice in style - Search Sensei's Swag and uncover hidden challenges to unlock more!

Want more fun? Go head-to-head and show off your skills as the ultimate ninja against your friends with local multiplayer and cut your way to the top!
